lines.en: I come knocking wood.
Each step lands with a thud.
I sway closer.

lines.zh: 我手里这根木棍，是换来的。
lines.en: This wooden club was traded for.

lines.zh: 我敲着木头走过来，一步一声。
lines.en: I come knocking wood, one thud per step.
I watch you as I walk.
My steps beat on the ground.
I circle the clearing.
I close in on you slowly.
I knock once more.
I turn the corner.
Each step lands with a thud.
I stand without moving.
The wood in my hand sways.
I prop my head up slowly.
I tip my head to the sound.
I stand still, holding the wood.
My breath beats like a drum.

lines.zh: 我把木头在地上敲了敲
lines.en: I tap the wood on the ground.
I wait for you to knock first.
I turn my neck slowly.
My hands hang down.
I tap the wood once more.
I wait where I am.
My shadow shifts slowly.
I stand and do not leave.
My head sways slowly.
I have not turned my eyes off you.
I raise my head level with yours.
I tip my head to study you.
Do you hear that sound?
I knock the wood once.
I am waiting for you to speak.
One step brings me near.
You look a little different.
I fix on that face of yours.
I slowly show my teeth.
Does this sound frighten you?
I stand not far from you.
I lift the wood.
Do not move.
I rarely let prey leave.
The blow puts me a step back.
A muffled note sounds in my throat.
I grip the wood tighter.
I lean over and brace.
Blood spots my coat.
I get my back straight again.

lines.zh: 一根木棍换来的蛋，不值钱。
lines.en: An egg bought with a stick—worth little.
I swing my head round once.
I have not stopped.
I raise the wood again.
You wave that thing about.
I tip my head to look.
That is not what I want.
I do not eat things like that.
I brush it aside.
I flick a glance at you.
This thing does not knock.
I prefer wood.
I turn away from it.
Do not try that on me.
You hit me; my feet do not move.

lines.zh: 十六根橡木六十四个棍子。
lines.en: Sixteen logs, sixty-four sticks.
I shoulder you back two steps.
That knock sounds like struck wood.
My foot slams down once.
I walk past you.
You knock me slightly aside.
I raise the wood to block.
This is no place to shove.
I step back into place.
Another comes knocking wood.
We knock twice together.
It stands half a head taller.
The two of us stand abreast.
We step toward you as one.
It knocks first.
I knock after it.
Not a word passes between us.
It takes its place behind me.
We sway along together.
I bend and pick up a piece of wood.
I tap it.
I snap it in two.
I hold it up to my eyes.
I toss it aside.
I pick up another.
I clamp a hand and hold.
I weigh how heavy it is.
I tuck it into my clothes.
I drop it and look away.
I raise my head and nail my feet.
I tighten my grip on the wood.
I press one step your way.
I hear you moving.
Lift it. I am ready.
My eyes lock onto you.
I knock the ground.
That sound is the start.
I have your position.
I sink my body down.
Wooden feet thud closer, tung tung tung.
This time I will not stop.
I wait for you to strike.

lines.zh: 我把木肩沉下，握紧球棒。
lines.en: I lower my wooden shoulder and grip the bat.
I follow without missing a step.
I do not fall behind.
I follow wherever you go.
I wait for your head to turn.
I hold the wood up.
I am patient; no rush.
You back off; I follow one step.

lines.zh: 我敲着棒子，一下又一下。
lines.en: I tap my bat, once and again.
Your back is open.
Three knocks on wood, and I am there.
This is close enough.
I can hear you panting.
You turn, and I move.
When you tire out, then I move.
My shadow touches your feet.
I bring the wood down.
My fist hits your chest.
The wood knocks your shoulder.
The blow puts you on your knees.
I add another knock.
I grab your clothes.

lines.zh: 我拿木棍敲你，一下比一下响。
lines.en: I beat you with my stick, louder each time.
That one rang out.
You dodge; I check my swing.
I give one laugh.
I walk out of the dark.
First I knock once.
I stand with the log, head tipped.
My shadow arrives first.
I stop in the clearing.
I will look at this place.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼看你，木棍还在肩上。
lines.en: I lift my eyes to you, the log still on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我身上的木头还在手边
lines.en: The wood stays by my hand.
The air goes quiet a moment.
I appear from behind the door.
I stamp my way to the centre.
I begin the second knock.
The sound carries far.
I wait by the wood for a sound.

lines.zh: 火一舔，我的木头开始焦。
lines.en: The flame licks me, and my wood chars.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的木腿裂了缝。
lines.en: I land, and a crack splits my wooden leg.

lines.zh: 水渗进木头，我沉得很快。
lines.en: Water seeps into my wood; I sink fast.
The blast throws me far.
Something sticks in me.
Spell light burns my arm.

lines.zh: 木头肚子空了，我站不稳。
lines.en: My wooden belly is empty; I can't stand straight.
Lightning runs down me.
The ground is gone.
